verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a Plaid feature for defining rules that automatically trigger actions on events. Plaid's webhooks only notify a developer's system about Item changes or async process status. Any rule logic and resulting action would have to be built by the developer, so webhooks are a developer building block (adjacent) rather than a rules-and-actions capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about changes to Plaid Items or the status of asynchronous processes.
